# RetainHQ

> A study tracker that logs what you learn automatically, then quizzes you on
> it right before you'd forget. RetainHQ measures what you still remember, not
> just what you completed.

The core loop: your study activity is logged (automatically by the RetainHQ
Companion browser extension, or by hand in a few seconds), RetainHQ captures
the one key memory that matters from it, and an FSRS-based scheduler brings
each topic back as a short review right before you'd forget it. A library of
interactive lessons (Python, SQL, DSA, aptitude, core CS, physics) feeds
extra cards into the same loop.

## Automatic logging

- The RetainHQ Companion is a browser extension (Chrome and Firefox) that
  turns the tutorials you watch, the docs you read, and the AI chats you learn
  from into study-log entries without any manual input.
- It is opt-in and consent-tiered; what it reads is described at
  https://retainhq.app/privacy/companion
- Anything the extension can't see can still be logged manually in the app.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://retainhq.app/): overview, core loop, sign-in
- [Roadmaps](https://retainhq.app/roadmaps): browsable lesson roadmaps by subject
- [Companion privacy policy](https://retainhq.app/privacy/companion): what the
  browser extension collects

## Notes for agents

- The app is a client-rendered React SPA; most routes require sign-in
  (Google OAuth) and render no meaningful content to an unauthenticated
  crawler beyond the homepage and the companion privacy policy.
- Lesson content lives under versioned JSON roadmaps and is not directly
  crawlable outside the app UI.
